items.text: Your safety while playing our games is our top priority.

We’ve been informed of a recent security vulnerability affecting Unity. Although no malicious activity has been detected in connection with this issue, we’re taking immediate action to keep our players protected.

A new update is now live on Naheulbeuk Amulet of Chaos and includes the necessary security fixes. We strongly encourage all players to update the game as soon as possible to ensure the best and most secure gameplay experience.
You can find additional details on Unity’s official website here:
Fixed softlock that could occur before the final fight if chapter 9 was done in a particular way
Fixed rare softlock involving traps and chickens
Fixed softlock when the Priestess' Youclidh's Slap AOE upgrade crit failed
Fixed issue with passive skills not being applied when changing weapons
Fixed some typos
Howdy, adventurers!

notes.title: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk - Last Orders Patch

items.text: The Last Orders Patch of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos is LIVE!

This will be the last update planned for the game! Thank you for all your support for the game. We are now focusing all our efforts in Naheulbeuk Dungeon Master, our new dungeon management game in this universe.
👉 Changelog - Last Orders Patch

Greetings, adventurers!
The biggest update so far from The Amulet of Chaos is here: Update 1.1!
We noticed after the game's release that, despite our testing and debug phases, several unexpected bugs had been encountered by players when they were playing.

This is why we decided to pre-launch the 1.1 update in a public beta: The Amulet of Chaos's players have the choice to activate the "Publicbetapatch1.1" branch on Steam to get the new functionalities right now, or wait until next week for the update to be implemented to the full game, with potentially a few corrections.

To all those who decide to try the 1.1 update tonight, we ask you to report us any bug you come across the same way it's been done before, by sending screens and context via mail here: bugs@artefacts-studio.fr.
For technical reasons, this public beta will only be available for Windows users. Be sure to restart your Steam client so the new branch appears!
Access it by right-clicking on the game's name in your library > Proprieties > Betas > "Publicbetapatch1.1"
The Ironman Mode is now available!
Various save fixes:
General: An option to disable the auto saves has been implemented (the auto saves are now disabled by default)
General: It is no longer possible to erase an auto save with a manual save
Combat: The game no longer auto saves during every round of combat
Combat: When enabled, the auto save will be done every X minutes, X being chosen by the player in the options
Exploration: No modification in exploration

Resistances' effects: We changed the way physical and magical resistance were taken into account when calculating area of effect's damages. Before this patch, there was only one dice roll for all enemies, and their resistances were compared to that one score. Now, there is one dice roll per enemy. This should reduce the impression that a spell either works perfectly or doesn't work at all
Additional Informations
Saves now indicate whether they were done in combat or exploration, and if they are compatible with the game's current version

Informations about physical and magical resistance were added to the character's information tab in battle: We also made more informations visible you can more easily plan combos including crowd control:

Informations about buffs and debuffs' length were added in the inventory, the skilltree and in battle: We also made more informations visible you can get a better idea of some skills/spells/items' power
Restart a battle: This functionality had been added to the Pause Menu during a battle and on the "Defeat" screen

End of battle's appreciations: The different bonuses applied to your characters' XP gains are now visible and explained. In addition to this, your performances in battle will be commented by the party!

Enhancement of the game's speed: Taking into account the community's feedback about the game being too slow, we've cut as much downtime as we could! You should notice visible ameliorations when interacting with an object while in exploration, and while executing an action in battle. The AI's reflexion time isn't affected by these modifications

Letting you know when you're overcharged: One of the most frequent bug reports we got was not linked to a bug: if your party starts walking instead of running, it's just because your inventory is full. In order to stop the confusion, we made it much more visible when you're overcharged and are carrying too much weight

The Born Leader achievement has been deleted: This achievement doesn't currently work the way we wanted it to, and a hard fix would be very heavy for the game and not really worth it. Given that only a few people unlocked it, we decided to delete it. For those of you who already unlocked it, we invite you to spread the legend of the mysterious 66th achievement!
A lot of miscellaneous bug fixes
Balance fixes (SPOILER ALERT)
PC's stuff: The Thief's Boots (light leather version) now grant you more movement in every direction (not just while retreating anymore)
Wheel of Misfortune: We slightly nerfed the wheel's buffs and debuffs
Books: The skills' damages were modified
Books: A bonus of magic resistance was added to the skill "Magic Reinforcement"
Codex Lich: Courage nerf
Barney: One mannequin that blocked the view has been deleted
Drunk Barney: Drunk Barney now summons spiders with an adjusted level
Team Mel: Mel now has 3 action points
Team Mel: His sidekicks are now more resistant
Guignax: The buff he receives at the beginning of the battle is now more powerful
Zangdar: The damages inflicted to his shield by music has been nerfed
Zangdar: Hit Points buff (except in Story mode)
Hello everyone!
As you may have noticed, several patches have been added to the Amulet of Chaos in the last few weeks. We’ve been hard at work to fix all the bugs you’ve reported to us!

Today’s patch also adds a new feature: the game now works with Steam Cloud, which saves your game files on Steam. Therefore, you won’t have to worry about losing your save if you change computers anymore!

Greetings, Adventurers!
The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos has been available since last Thursday on PC and Mac. We’re very proud to see how many of you have already started this epic and hilarious adventure!

We are very grateful for the bug reports we received from you all in order to fix the game’s problems as soon and as well as possible. A first patch was pushed this week-end to correct the first major problems we learned about and the second one is on its way!

notes.title: Today's patch aims to correct the following points

items.text: Combat: Correction of a showstopper bug following a critical failure during one of the Evil Thief’s attacks.
Exploration: Loot tweaking in the tutorial.
General: Correction of a critical bug that blocks loading your saves after a certain point during Chapter 6.

General: Correction of a critical bug which prevents the game from launching if a save has been corrupted.: We do not intend to stop here! Before the end of this week, a new patch will be ready and, if necessary, another will shortly follow. Here are the points we intend to correct with those upcoming patches:
Combat: Fixing a showstopper bug linked to a critical failure when launching the Dwarf.
Combat: fixing a showstopper bug that might happen during the kitchen fight and the fight against Dlul’s followers.
Combat: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen if you finish the Misfortune Wheel fight with a charmed character.
Exploration: Fixing a collision bug in the garden.
Exploration: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen when you interact with a merchant directly after changing the difficulty.
Exploration: Fixing a bug in Binsc and Moo’s quest.
General: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen when you deactivate the automatic turn endings in a game without the tutorial.
General: Wounds tweaking in the tutorial.

General: Incrase of the number of automatic saves, from 3 to 10.: If you noticed a bug that is not listed above, please report it to our new email address made especially for this purpose: bugs@artefacts-studio.fr: Thank you all!
Note: at the time of publication, the patch is live on PC and will soon be live on MAC.
Hello adventurers!

The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos just launched on Thursday and we've consistently been reading your feedback since! We're very happy with the game's reception, you seem to be many enjoying spending time with our crazy cast of characters and exploring the dungeon.

We've also seen some of you report bugs and issues. The dev team is still hard at work on the game, taking your feedback to support the game post launch and deliver patches. So without further ado, here are the patch notes!
AI: Rare game progression bug fixed
AI: The chickens' AI has been altered so that they prefer to hit characters rather than furniture
Controller support: now fully functional when the controller is plugged in after the game has already been launched
Combat: Bug where the game didn't progress at the end of a fight when you finished by killing an enemy covered in beer/ice/poison/fire has been fixed
Exploration: VIP Square entrance progression bug has been fixed
Exploration: Game progression bug happening in the Binsc & Moo quest has been fixed
General: Bug causing increased dodging/blocking and resistance than anticipated has been fixed
General: Maximum FPS without V-sync has been reduced from 240 to 120
General: Some game text has been corrected: Thank you again for your support and see you around in the dungeon of Naheulbeuk!
